source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 22 (PDF 88-100), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 22 (Hydroxy Compounds) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In phenols, the hydroxyl group is attached to:
(Phenols mein hydroxyl group kis se juda hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols mein -OH aliphatic carbon par hota hai; phenols mein aryl (aromatic ring wala) carbon par (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Alcohols and phenols are hydroxy organic compounds with at least one hydroxyl group attached to an aliphatic or an aryl carbon, respectively.

blocks.prompt:
2 Ethanol is also known as:
(Ethanol ka doosra naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanol ko ethyl alcohol ya grain alcohol bhi kehte hain; carbolic acid phenol ka naam hai (Introduction, 22.5).

book_ref.quote: Almost everyone is aware of ethanol, also known as ethyl alcohol or grain alcohol.

blocks.prompt:
3 Phenol solutions were used from 1867 to clean surgical instruments and wounds. Why were alternatives later found?
(1867 se surgical auzaar aur zakhm phenol solution se saaf kiye jate thay. Baad mein is ke mutabadil (alternatives) kyun dhoonde gaye?)

options.text: Phenol room temperature par gas hai
Phenol steel ke auzaar se react karta hai
Phenol sehatmand tissues ko jalata hai

blocks.explanation: Phenol taaqatwar antiseptic hai magar sehatmand tissues ko jala deta hai, is liye mutabadil dhoonde gaye (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Since phenol burns healthy tissues, it was too potent for this use

blocks.prompt:
4 The functional group of all alcohols is:
(Tamam alcohols ka functional group kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydroxyl group (-OH) tamam alcohols ka functional group hai (22.1).

book_ref.quote: Hydroxyl group (-OH) is the functional group of all alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
5 In the general formula ROH of an alcohol, R is:
(Alcohol ke general formula ROH mein R kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohol mein R alkyl group hai; agar -OH aryl carbon par ho to compound phenol hota hai (22.1, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: In an alcohol, R is an alkyl group.

blocks.prompt:
6 Which familiar substances are included in the alcohol family?
(Kaun si jaani pehchani cheezein alcohol family mein shamil hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohol family mein cholesterol aur carbohydrates bhi shamil hain (22.1).

book_ref.quote: The family also includes familiar substances as cholesterol and the carbohydrates.

blocks.prompt:
7 The second member of the homologous series of monohydric alcohols is:
(Monohydric alcohols ki homologous series ka doosra member kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methanol (CH₃OH) aur ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH) pehle do members hain (22.1).

book_ref.quote: Methanol (CH₃OH) and ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH) are the first two members of the homologous series of monohydric alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
8 Glycerol contains three -OH groups. It is classified as a:
(Glycerol mein teen -OH groups hain. Is ki darja-bandi kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: -OH groups ki tadaad se alcohols monohydric aur polyhydric hain; glycerol mein teen hain, is liye polyhydric (22.1).

book_ref.quote: Depending on the number of hydroxyl groups attached, alcohols can be classified into monohydric and polyhydric alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
9 The IUPAC name of glycol is:
(Glycol ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glycol 1,2-ethanediol hai aur glycerol 1,2,3-propanetriol (22.1).

book_ref.quote: Depending on the number of hydroxyl groups attached, alcohols can be classified into monohydric and polyhydric alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
10 Alcohols are classified as primary, secondary or tertiary according to the number of:
(Alcohols ko primary, secondary ya tertiary kis cheez ki tadaad se kaha jata hai?)

options.text: -OH wale carbon se seedhe jude carbon atoms
sab se lambi chain ke carbon atoms

blocks.explanation: Qisam is par mabni hai ke -OH wale carbon se kitne carbon atoms seedhe jude hain (22.1).

book_ref.quote: Depending on the number of carbon atoms which are directly attached to the carbon that is bonded with the -OH group

blocks.prompt:
11 The general formula of a secondary alcohol is:
(Secondary alcohol ka general formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary R₁CH₂OH, secondary R₂CHOH, tertiary R₃COH (22.1).

book_ref.quote: Its general formula is R₂CHOH.

blocks.prompt:
12 Which general formula represents a tertiary alcohol?
(Kaun sa general formula tertiary alcohol ko zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tertiary (3°) alcohol mein -OH tertiary carbon par hota hai: R₃COH (22.1).

book_ref.quote: Its general formula is R₃COH.

blocks.prompt:
13 Propan-2-ol, CH₃CH(OH)CH₃, is a:
(Propan-2-ol, CH₃CH(OH)CH₃, kis qisam ka alcohol hai?)
blocks.explanation: -OH wala carbon do carbon atoms se juda hai, yani secondary carbon: propan-2-ol 2° alcohol hai (22.1).

book_ref.quote: A secondary (2°) alcohol is one in which the OH group is attached to a secondary carbon atom.

blocks.prompt:
14 Which of these is a primary alcohol?
(In mein se primary alcohol kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Propan-1-ol, CH₃CH₂CH₂OH, mein -OH wala carbon sirf aik carbon se juda hai (R₁CH₂OH), is liye primary (22.1).

book_ref.quote: A primary (1°) alcohol is one in which the OH group is attached a primary carbon atom.

blocks.prompt:
15 In the equilibrium ROH(aq) ⇌ RO⁻(aq) + H⁺(aq), the position of equilibrium:
(ROH(aq) ⇌ RO⁻(aq) + H⁺(aq) equilibrium mein position kahan hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols ki dissociation (toot kar ions banna) kam hai, is liye molecules ions se bohat ziyada hain; equilibrium left par hai (22.2).

book_ref.quote: Alcohols have a low degree of dissociation.

blocks.prompt:
16 Alcohols are weaker acids than water because in solution they have:
(Alcohols paani se kamzor acids kyun hain? Solution mein un ka:)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols ke solution mein [H⁺(aq)] paani se kam hai, is liye woh kamzor acids hain (22.2).

book_ref.quote: As alcohols have a lower [H⁺(aq)] in solution compared to water, alcohols are weaker acids than water.

blocks.prompt:
17 Alkyl groups push electrons into a covalent bond. They are said to have:
(Alkyl groups covalent bond mein electrons dhakelte hain. Kaha jata hai ke un ka:)
blocks.explanation: Electron dene wale groups (jaise alkyl) ka positive inductive effect hota hai (22.2).

book_ref.quote: Electron-donating species push electrons into a covalent bond and are said to have a positive inductive effect.

blocks.prompt:
18 The effect of the alkyl group on the ethoxide ion is that it:
(Alkyl group ka ethoxide ion par kya asar hai?)

options.text: charge phaila kar mustahkam karta hai
O par electron density barha kar ghair-mustahkam karta hai

blocks.explanation: Electron dene wala alkyl group O par electron density barhata hai aur alkoxide ion ko ghair-mustahkam (unstable) karta hai (22.2).

book_ref.quote: The alkyl groups destabilize the alkoxide ion, which is formed by removing one proton (H⁺) from the alcohol molecule.

blocks.prompt:
19 Because of extra electron density on its oxygen atom, an alkoxide ion is more likely to:
(Oxygen par ziyada electron density ki wajah se alkoxide ion kya karne ka ziyada imkaan rakhta hai?)

options.text: H⁺ le kar dobara alcohol banana
electrons ko current ki shakal mein dena

blocks.explanation: O par ziyada electron density se alkoxide ion H⁺ le kar dobara alcohol bana leta hai (22.2).

book_ref.quote: The alkoxide ion is, therefore, more likely to accept an H⁺ ion and form the alcohol again.

blocks.prompt:
20 The conjugate base of phenol is the:
(Phenol ka conjugate base kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenol se H⁺ nikalne par phenoxide ion banta hai, jo is ka conjugate base hai (22.2).

book_ref.quote: The delocalisation stabilises the phenoxide ion, the conjugate base of phenol.

blocks.prompt:
21 The phenoxide ion is stable because:
(Phenoxide ion mustahkam (stable) kyun hai?)

options.text: alkyl group oxygen par electrons dhakelta hai
oxygen par koi lone pair nahi
ring mein koi π electrons nahi
oxygen ka lone pair ring ke π system se overlap karta hai

blocks.explanation: Oxygen ka aik lone pair ring ke delocalised π system se overlap karta hai aur negative charge ring par phail jata hai (22.2).

book_ref.quote: This is possible as one of the lone pairs on the oxygen atom overlaps with the delocalised π system of the ring.

blocks.prompt:
22 Compared with the ethoxide ion, the oxygen atom of the phenoxide ion has:
(Ethoxide ion ke muqable mein phenoxide ion ke oxygen par:)
blocks.explanation: Delocalisation ki wajah se oxygen par charge density kam hoti hai, is liye H⁺ zor se wapas nahi khinchta (22.2).

book_ref.quote: Because of this delocalisation, there is less charge density on the oxygen atom.

blocks.prompt:
23 The correct order of acidity is:
(Acidity ki sahih tarteeb kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acidity ki tarteeb: phenol > water > ethanol (22.2).

book_ref.quote: The relative acidities are as follows: phenol > water > ethanol

blocks.prompt:
24 Phenol is more likely to:
(Phenol kya karne ka ziyada imkaan rakhta hai?)

options.text: proton le kar base ki tarah
proton kho kar acid ki tarah

blocks.explanation: Phenoxide ion mustahkam hai, is liye phenol proton khota hai (acid) na ke leta hai (22.2).

book_ref.quote: This means that phenol is more likely to lose a proton (and act as an acid) rather than to gain a proton (and act as a base).

blocks.prompt:
25 The catalyst used when ethene reacts with steam to form ethanol is:
(Ethene aur steam se ethanol bante waqt kaun sa catalyst istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Garam steam aur alkene, concentrated phosphoric acid catalyst ke saath, alcohol dete hain (22.3 i).

book_ref.quote: When hot steam is reacted with an alkene, using concentrated phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄) as a catalyst, electrophilic addition takes place to form an alcohol.

blocks.prompt:
26 The reaction of an alkene with steam to give an alcohol is a type of:
(Alkene aur steam se alcohol banne wala reaction kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: H₃PO₄ catalyst ke saath alkene par steam ka electrophilic addition hota hai (22.3 i).

book_ref.quote: When hot steam is reacted with an alkene, using concentrated phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄) as a catalyst, electrophilic addition takes place to form an alcohol.

blocks.prompt:
27 An alkene treated with cold, dilute KMnO₄ forms a:
(Alkene ko cold, dilute KMnO₄ se treat karne par kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cold, dilute KMnO₄ halka oxidising agent hai jo alkene ko diol (do -OH wala alcohol) bana deta hai (22.3 ii).

book_ref.quote: Alcohols are obtained by the oxidation of alkenes with cold, dilute KMnO₄, a mild oxidising agent.

blocks.prompt:
28 Bromoethane heated with aqueous NaOH gives ethanol by:
(Bromoethane ko aqueous NaOH ke saath garam karne se ethanol kis tareeqe se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aqueous NaOH ke saath garam karne par halogen ki jagah -OH aata hai: nucleophilic substitution (22.3 iii).

book_ref.quote: The halogen atom in halogenoalkanes can be substituted by –OH group when heated with aqueous NaOH in a nucleophilic substitution reaction, giving an alcohol.

blocks.prompt:
29 Propanone is reduced with NaBH₄. The product is:
(Propanone ko NaBH₄ se reduce kiya jaye to kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ketones reduce ho kar secondary alcohols bante hain; propanone se propan-2-ol (22.3 iv).

book_ref.quote: Ketones are reduced to secondary alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
30 Reduction of ethanal with LiAlH₄ gives:
(Ethanal ko LiAlH₄ se reduce karne par kya milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldehydes reduce ho kar primary alcohols bante hain; ethanal se ethanol (22.3 iv).

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes are reduced to primary alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
31 Ethanoic acid is converted into ethanol by:
(Ethanoic acid ko ethanol mein kis cheez se badla jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carboxylic acids LiAlH₄ se reduce ho kar primary alcohols bante hain (22.3 v).

book_ref.quote: Similarly, carboxylic acids are reduced by LiAlH₄ to primary alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
32 Ethyl ethanoate heated with dilute acid is hydrolysed to:
(Ethyl ethanoate ko dilute acid ke saath garam karne par hydrolysis se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ester ki hydrolysis (paani se todna) se carboxylic acid aur alcohol bante hain: ethanoic acid aur ethanol (22.3 vi).

book_ref.quote: When an ester is heated with dilute acid or alkali, hydrolysis takes place and a carboxylic acid and alcohol are formed.

blocks.prompt:
33 Which of the following is NOT listed as a starting material for preparing alcohols?
(In mein se kaun alcohols banane ke shuruati maaddon mein shamil NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols alkenes, halogenoalkanes, carbonyl compounds, carboxylic acids aur esters se bante hain (22.3).

book_ref.quote: Alcohols can be prepared from alkenes, halogenoalkanes, carbonyl compounds, carboxylic acids, and esters.

blocks.prompt:
34 The products of complete combustion of ethanol are:
(Ethanol ke mukammal combustion (jalne) se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols jalne par carbon dioxide aur paani dete hain (22.4 i).

book_ref.quote: Alcohols when ignited, undergo complete combustion to form carbon dioxide and water.

blocks.prompt:
35 In CH₃CH₂OH + 3O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O, the number of moles of O₂ needed to burn 0.5 mol of ethanol completely is:
(CH₃CH₂OH + 3O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O mein 0.5 mol ethanol ko poora jalane ke liye kitne mol O₂ chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 1 mol ethanol ko 3 mol O₂ chahiye, to 0.5 mol ko 0.5 × 3 = 1.5 mol (22.4 i).

book_ref.quote: Alcohols when ignited, undergo complete combustion to form carbon dioxide and water.

blocks.prompt:
36 ΔH°c of ethanol is −1367 kJ mol⁻¹. The heat released when 2 mol of ethanol burn completely is:
(Ethanol ka ΔH°c −1367 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. 2 mol ethanol ke poora jalne par kitni heat nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Heat = 2 × 1367 = 2734 kJ nikalti hai (22.4 i).

book_ref.quote: The above reaction is highly exothermic; this is why the alcohol is used as an alternate to petrol in some countries.

blocks.prompt:
37 Alcohol is used as an alternative to petrol in some countries because its combustion is:
(Kuch mulkon mein alcohol petrol ki jagah kyun istemal hota hai? Is ka combustion:)
blocks.explanation: Ethanol ka combustion bohat exothermic (heat dene wala) hai, is liye fuel hai (22.4 i).

book_ref.quote: The above reaction is highly exothermic; this is why the alcohol is used as an alternate to petrol in some countries.

blocks.prompt:
38 When ethanol reacts with HCl in the presence of ZnCl₂, the product is:
(Ethanol ZnCl₂ ki mojoodgi mein HCl se react kare to kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂OH + HCl → CH₃CH₂Cl + H₂O (ZnCl₂): -OH ki jagah Cl aata hai (22.4 ii).

book_ref.quote: In the substitution of alcohols, a hydroxy group (-OH) is replaced by another substituent (e.g. halogens) to form a new product (e.g., halogenoalkanes).

blocks.prompt:
39 Substitution of the -OH group of an alcohol by a halogen gives a:
(Alcohol ke -OH ki jagah halogen aa jaye to kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Substitution mein -OH ki jagah halogen aa kar halogenoalkane banta hai (22.4 ii).

book_ref.quote: In the substitution of alcohols, a hydroxy group (-OH) is replaced by another substituent (e.g. halogens) to form a new product (e.g., halogenoalkanes).

blocks.prompt:
40 When sodium reacts with an alcohol, the gas given off is:
(Sodium alcohol se react kare to kaun si gas nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: O-H bond toot-ta hai; hydrogen gas nikalti hai aur alkoxide banta hai; H₂ ke bulbule -OH group ki nishani hain (22.4 iii).

book_ref.quote: This reaction can be used as a test for hydroxy (-OH) group.

blocks.prompt:
41 Compared with the reaction of sodium with water, its reaction with ethanol is:
(Sodium ka paani ke muqable mein ethanol se reaction kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanol ke saath reaction paani ke muqable mein kam tez hai (22.4 iii).

book_ref.quote: Though the reaction is less vigorous than sodium reacting with water

blocks.prompt:
42 Sodium is added separately to phenolphthalein in ethanol and in water. What is observed?
(Sodium ko alag alag phenolphthalein wale ethanol aur paani mein dala jaye to kya nazar aata hai?)

options.text: Ethanol mein foran, paani mein aahista
Ethanol mein pink rang aahista, paani mein foran

blocks.explanation: Ethanol mein pink rang aahista aur paani mein foran banta hai; yani Na ethanol se aahista react karta hai (22.4 iii box).

book_ref.quote: When sodium metal is added to a solution of phenolphthalein and ethanol, pink colour is formed slowly.

blocks.prompt:
43 After sodium reacts with ethanol and the excess ethanol is evaporated, the white crystalline solid left is:
(Sodium aur ethanol ke reaction ke baad zaa'id ethanol urane par kaun sa safed crystalline solid bachta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sodium alkoxide (yahan sodium ethoxide) ka safed crystalline solid bachta hai (22.4 iii).

book_ref.quote: If the excess ethanol is evaporated off after the reaction, a white crystalline solid of sodium alkoxide is left.

blocks.prompt:
44 Which alcohol reacts least vigorously with sodium?
(Kaun sa alcohol sodium se sab se kam tezi se react karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrocarbon chain jitni lambi, reaction utna kam tez; yahan butan-1-ol ki chain sab se lambi hai (22.4 iii).

book_ref.quote: The longer the hydrocarbon chain in the alcohol, the less vigorous the reaction becomes.

blocks.prompt:
45 Using 2CH₃CH₂OH + 2Na → 2CH₃CH₂ONa + H₂, the moles of H₂ formed from 0.3 mol of ethanol with excess sodium are:
(2CH₃CH₂OH + 2Na → 2CH₃CH₂ONa + H₂ ke mutabiq 0.3 mol ethanol aur zaa'id sodium se kitne mol H₂ banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2 mol ethanol se 1 mol H₂, to 0.3 mol se 0.3 ÷ 2 = 0.15 mol (22.4 iii).

book_ref.quote: If the excess ethanol is evaporated off after the reaction, a white crystalline solid of sodium alkoxide is left.

blocks.prompt:
46 Oxidation of ethanol with acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ first gives:
(Ethanol ko acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se oxidise karne par pehle kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary alcohols oxidise ho kar aldehydes bante hain: CH₃CH₂OH + [O] → CH₃CHO + H₂O (22.4 iv).

book_ref.quote: Primary alcohols can be oxidised to form aldehydes and the secondary alcohols can be oxidised to form only ketones using oxidizing agents.

blocks.prompt:
47 Propan-2-ol on oxidation gives:
(Propan-2-ol oxidise ho kar kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secondary alcohol sirf ketone banta hai: CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ + [O] → CH₃COCH₃ + H₂O (22.4 iv).

book_ref.quote: Primary alcohols can be oxidised to form aldehydes and the secondary alcohols can be oxidised to form only ketones using oxidizing agents.

blocks.prompt:
48 Which alcohol does NOT undergo oxidation with acidified K₂Cr₂O₇?
(Kaun sa alcohol acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se oxidise NAHI hota?)
blocks.explanation: Tertiary alcohols oxidise nahi hote; 2-methylpropan-2-ol tertiary hai (22.4 iv).

book_ref.quote: Tertiary alcohols do not undergo oxidation.

blocks.prompt:
49 When a primary alcohol is warmed with acidified K₂Cr₂O₇, the colour changes from:
(Primary alcohol ko acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ke saath garam karne par rang kis se kis mein badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Orange Cr₂O₇²⁻ ions reduce ho kar green Cr³⁺ ions bante hain (22.4 iv).

book_ref.quote: When alcohols are oxidised the orange dichromate ions (Cr₂O₇²⁻) are reduced to green Cr³⁺ ions.

blocks.prompt:
50 The green colour formed when an alcohol reduces acidified dichromate is due to:
(Alcohol jab acidified dichromate ko reduce kare to green rang kis ki wajah se hai?)
blocks.explanation: Orange Cr₂O₇²⁻ reduce ho kar green Cr³⁺ banta hai (22.4 iv).

book_ref.quote: When alcohols are oxidised the orange dichromate ions (Cr₂O₇²⁻) are reduced to green Cr³⁺ ions.

blocks.prompt:
51 Potassium dichromate(VI) is used in an acidic medium because the acid:
(Potassium dichromate(VI) acidic medium mein kyun istemal hota hai? Acid:)

options.text: alcohol ko seedha oxidise karta hai
dichromate ke reduction ke liye H⁺ ions deta hai

blocks.explanation: Dichromate ke reduction ko H⁺ ions chahiye jo acidic medium deta hai (22.4 iv, Keep in Mind).

book_ref.quote: This reduction requires hydrogen (H⁺) ions which are provided by the acidic medium.

blocks.prompt:
52 The correct name of K₂Cr₂O₇ is:
(K₂Cr₂O₇ ka sahih naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: K₂Cr₂O₇ potassium dichromate(VI) hai; potassium chromate(VI) K₂CrO₄ hai (22.4 iv, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: K₂Cr₂O₇ is potassium dichromate(VI), not potassium chromate(VI) (which is K₂CrO₄)

blocks.prompt:
53 Three tubes of warm acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ contain propan-1-ol, propan-2-ol and 2-methylpropan-2-ol. The solution stays orange in the tube with:
(Teen tubes mein garam acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ hai jin mein propan-1-ol, propan-2-ol aur 2-methylpropan-2-ol hain. Kis tube mein rang orange hi rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf primary aur secondary alcohols green karte hain; tertiary 2-methylpropan-2-ol se rang nahi badalta (22.4 iv).

book_ref.quote: no colour change is observed with 2-methyl-propan-2-ol, which is a tertiary alcohol

blocks.prompt:
54 Besides acidified K₂Cr₂O₇, which oxidising agent is named for alcohols?
(Acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ke ilawa alcohols ke liye kaun sa oxidising agent bataya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols ke oxidising agents acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ aur acidified KMnO₄ hain; NaBH₄ aur LiAlH₄ reducing agents hain (22.4 iv).

book_ref.quote: The oxidising agents for alcohols include acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ and acidified KMnO₄.

blocks.prompt:
55 In a breathalyser, the current measured comes from:
(Breathalyser mein naapa jane wala current kahan se aata hai?)

options.text: ethanol ke oxidation mein jazb hue electrons
saans ke ethanol ke oxidation se nikle electrons

blocks.explanation: Oxidation electrons deti hai; ethanol ke chhode hue electrons current banate hain jo alcohol ki miqdaar ke mutanasib hai (22.4 iv, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: Oxidation releases electrons; it does not require them.

blocks.prompt:
56 The formula of the manganate(VII) ion is:
(Manganate(VII) ion ka formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Manganate(VII) ion MnO₄⁻ hai (22.4 iv, Quick Check 22.4 b).

book_ref.quote: What colour change would you observe when alcohols are oxidised with manganate ions (MnO₄⁻).

blocks.prompt:
57 Dehydration of an alcohol is a type of:
(Alcohol ki dehydration kis qisam ka reaction hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dehydration elimination reaction hai jis mein paani ka aik molecule nikal jata hai (22.4 v).

book_ref.quote: Dehydration is the type of the elimination reaction in which a water molecule is removed.

blocks.prompt:
58 Dehydration of ethanol gives:
(Ethanol ki dehydration se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols dehydrate ho kar alkenes bante hain; ethanol se ethene aur paani (22.4 v).

book_ref.quote: Alcohols can also undergo dehydration to form alkenes.

blocks.prompt:
59 Which of these is NOT a dehydrating agent for alcohols?
(In mein se kaun alcohols ke liye dehydrating agent NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dehydrating agents aluminium oxide, conc. sulphuric acid aur conc. phosphoric acid hain; NaBH₄ reducing agent hai (22.4 v, 22.3).

book_ref.quote: Dehydrating agents may be aluminium oxide, conc. sulphuric, acid, conc phosphoric acid, etc.

blocks.prompt:
60 The formula of the simplest phenol is:
(Sab se saada phenol ka formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se saada phenol C₆H₅OH hai (22.5).

book_ref.quote: The chemical formula of the simplest phenol is C₆H₅OH.

blocks.prompt:
61 Phenol is also known as:
(Phenol ko aur kis naam se jaana jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenol ko carbolic acid bhi kehte hain aur yeh carbolic soap mein istemal hua (22.5).

book_ref.quote: Phenol is also known as carbolic acid and was used as carbolic soap.

blocks.prompt:
62 At room conditions phenol is a:
(Aam halaat mein phenol kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenol safed crystalline (qalmi) solid hai (22.5).

book_ref.quote: Phenol is a crystalline white solid.

blocks.prompt:
63 Which compound is an example of a phenol?
(Kaun sa compound phenol ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenol, 2-naphthol aur 1-naphthol phenols ki misaalein hain (22.5).

book_ref.quote: Examples of phenols: phenol, 2-naphthol and 1-naphthol

blocks.prompt:
64 Phenol can be prepared from phenylamine by reacting it with:
(Phenylamine se phenol banane ke liye isay kis se react karaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenols phenylamine aur nitrous acid ke reaction se bante hain (22.5).

book_ref.quote: Phenols can be produced by the reaction of phenylamine with nitrous acid (HNO₂).

blocks.prompt:
65 The nitrous acid for the preparation of phenol is made in situ from:
(Phenol ki tayyari ke liye nitrous acid in situ (wahin) kin cheezon se banaya jata hai?)

options.text: NaNO₂ aur dilute HCl, 10°C se kam
